subject: SCIENCE
title: Animal Parts at Work
objective: Explain that animal body parts can support different functions.

items.prompt: Which statement about animal body parts is true?

options.text: The same kind of part may have different functions across species.

items.explanation: The same part can do different jobs in different animals — a tail may help balance or send signals. Not every tail does the same thing, and not every winged animal flies.

items.prompt: Which pair matches a body part to its job?
items.explanation: Fins push against water so fish can swim. Fins do not help flying, and wings do not help digging.
Tails do many jobs — balance, steering, and even signaling — so they do not have just one function. Fins help swimming, and wings help flight.

items.prompt: Which part often helps a fish swim?
items.explanation: Fins push against the water to move a fish forward. Fur and antlers do not help fish swim.

items.prompt: Which pair matches a body part to its job?

options.text: tails may aid balance or communication

items.explanation: Some tails help animals balance or send signals. Wings do not help swimming, and fins do not help flying.
